summary: FDM-printable compact Mini-ITX sandwich enclosure with motherboard/cooler on the front side and a riser-mounted GPU plus 160 x 80 x 40 mm 1U PSU on the rear side.

required_interfaces.description: Visually and structurally verify the fully rebuilt top, Mini-ITX, PSU, riser, GPU and magnet screw-hole patterns declared by the current CAD brief.
Fit and retain a standard 170 x 170 mm Mini-ITX motherboard with accessible rear I/O.
Fit the Thermalright AXP120-X67 envelope and preserve side-panel intake clearance.
Rear-mount the approved compact GPU envelope behind the motherboard tray, including I/O bracket, PCIe riser path, and power-cable bend space.
Rear-mount the user-specified 160 x 80 x 40 mm compact 1U PSU behind the motherboard tray with AC inlet access, airflow, retention, and cable routing.
Provide one externally accessible power button with an internal path to the motherboard header.

assembly_story.installation: Place each foot directly under its corner-column axis, then fasten each independent column from below with one kit-selected M3 socket-cap screw passing through the foot and 3 mm base into the column; install the sixteen 10 x 10 x 3 mm countersunk magnets directly into the column pockets with centered M3 screws, mount motherboard, PCIe riser and GPU, then install the selected PSU and route cables before fitting the four magnetically retained perimeter panels.
assembly_story.maintenance: Pull off the magnetically retained front, rear, left, or right service panel without tools; locating lips carry panel shear while magnets provide normal retention.

documents.description: Complete printable Mini-ITX enclosure assembly with four independently printable, underside-screwed corner columns
